feature.title: Combat Intro
feature.hint: A cinematic, full-screen start to a PF2e encounter: the roster, the title and the threat, every player's initiative rolled on their own Dice So Nice dice, then the cards sort into the tracker.

cssOnly.name: CSS-only cinematic
cssOnly.hint: Never compile the WebGL backdrop on this client. The CSS backdrop carries every beat on its own.

volume.name: Cinematic volume
volume.hint: Master volume for the combat intro's sound cues.

introHit.name: Sound: Intro hit
introHit.hint: The low hit that opens the sequence. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

rosterTick.name: Sound: Roster tick
rosterTick.hint: Each side of the roster arriving, and the threat readout. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

titleSlam.name: Sound: Title strike
titleSlam.hint: The encounter title striking. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

throw.name: Sound: Throw
throw.hint: A die leaving its card. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

dieLand.name: Sound: Die lands
dieLand.hint: A die landing on its face. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

seal.name: Sound: Seal
seal.hint: A sealed die landing, and the seals breaking at the sort. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

sortTick.name: Sound: Sort
sortTick.hint: The cards travelling into initiative order. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

dockIn.name: Sound: Dock
dockIn.hint: The cards docking into the tracker. Leave blank to use the skin's own sound.

settings.skinHint: The look follows the initiative tracker's Skin setting, so the cinematic and the tracker always match.

warn.noDice: Combat Intro needs Dice So Nice 6 or newer.
warn.noCombatants: There is nobody to roll initiative for.
warn.running: A cinematic start is already running for this encounter.
warn.noGM: A GM has to be connected to run the cinematic start.
warn.commitFailed: Combat Intro could not commit the initiative values. Press Roll remaining to try again, or Cancel.
